blocks.html: This method retrieves a view configuration by its ID.

types.name: entity
types.description: The entity the view configuration belongs to.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the view configuration to retrieve.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the view configuration.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: entity
children.description: The entity this configuration is for (e.g., "order", "product").

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the view configuration.

children.name: user_id
children.description: The ID of the user who owns this configuration, or null for system defaults.

children.name: is_system_default
children.description: Whether this is a system default configuration.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the view configuration was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the view configuration was updated.
